source: release-plan-2026-10-25/inputs/page-inventory.tsv: the 469 rows with page=True, in file order; id PG-nnn is the row number among them. NP-01 to NP-14 are screens on the rebuild branch that the inventory (which describes main) does not list: ten for W1 (the onboarding, billing and error screens the W1 outcome needs) and four for W4 (the GitHub connector, its review page, the connected-assistants page and the assistant consent page).
state_values: compliant, not-compliant, not-scanned: template compliance on the rebuild branch from launch-bars/PAGE-COMPLIANCE.json (399 templates scanned, 121 compliant); not-scanned means the page's primary template is not in that scan; new-on-branch: not in the inventory and not yet scanned (the scan must be extended to it before its wave gate)
changes_from_v1: 15 W1 pages to RT or elsewhere (12 redirect inside W1, 3 redirect with W3); 10 new W1 screens; 4 new W4 screens; W2 gains the Composer, the capability fact sheet and the impact page, loses 4; W3 split into families a and b, loses 23 to RT, 1 to W5, 2 to W2, gains 2 un-retired; W4 loses 3 to RT; W5 loses 51 to RT and 3 to early access, gains 7; W6 loses 10 to RT; five un-retired (PG-116, PG-203, PG-430, PG-440, PG-450); three confirmed retirements held as pages until their owner confirms (PG-208, PG-209, PG-434); the redirect list regenerated from the consolidation map (differences in release-plan-v2.md section 7)

reason_codes.PG-RT: Duplicate or retired surface, decision confirmed: the address redirects (field to) to its canonical page when that page is live (field ships); until then it answers the early-access page. Counted retired in the gate.
reason_codes.PG-RTP: Redirect decided but not yet confirmed by the owner (the consolidation map marks the row low confidence, or the product manager's review holds it): the page stays in its wave and must pass that wave's gate; not counted retired until the owner confirms; the redirect then ships at the wave in field ships
